name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
summary: Provides credit-linked capital subsidy for the formalization and upgradation of micro food processing enterprises.
benefit_description: Credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of Rs. 10,00,000 per unit.

criteria.description: The enterprise should employ less than 10 workers.
criteria.source_quote: The enterprise should be unincorporated and should employ less than 10 workers.

criteria.description: Applicant should be above 18 years of age and possess at least VIII standard pass educational qualification.
criteria.source_quote: The applicant should be above 18 years of age and should possess at least VIII standard pass educational qualification.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Apply for Permanent Account Number via NSDL/UTIITSL
Provide a 6-month transaction statement from your operating bank
document_requirements.source_quote: Photocopy of Bank Statement/ Bank Passbook for the last 6 months of the firm.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Register the firm on the official Udyam portal

windows.notes: Open year-round via the PMFME portal online.

benefits.description: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of eligible project cost
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: The beneficiary contribution should be a minimum of 10% of the project cost with the balance being loaned from the Bank.
benefits.source_quote: Individual micro food processing units would be provided credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹ 10,00,000 per unit.
